title: CARD: Cluster-level Adaptation with Reward-guided Decoding for Personalized Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2601.06352v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Adapting large language models to individual users remains challenging due to the tension between fine-grained personalization and scalable deployment. We present CARD, a hierarchical framework that achieves effective personalization through progressive refinement. CARD first clusters users according to shared stylistic patterns and learns group-specific LoRA adapters, enabling robust generalization and strong low-resource performance. To capture individual differences within each cluster, we propose an implicit preference learning mechanism that contrasts user-authored text with cluster-level generations, allowing the model to infer user-specific style preferences without manual annotation. At inference time, CARD injects personalization exclusively at decoding via lightweight user preference vectors and low-rank logit corrections, while keeping the base model frozen. translated_title: CARD：基于聚类级适应与奖励引导解码的个性化文本生成
translated_abstract: 将大型语言模型适配到个体用户仍然具有挑战性，原因在于细粒度个性化与可扩展部署之间存在矛盾。我们提出了CARD，一个通过渐进式细化实现有效个性化的分层框架。CARD首先根据共享的风格模式对用户进行聚类，并学习组特定的LoRA适配器，从而实现稳健的泛化能力和出色的低资源性能。为了捕捉每个聚类内部的个体差异，我们提出了一种隐式偏好学习机制，该机制将用户撰写的文本与聚类级别的生成结果进行对比，使模型无需人工标注即可推断用户特定的风格偏好。在推理时，CARD仅通过轻量级的用户偏好向量和低秩logit修正将个性化注入解码过程，同时保持基础模型冻结。在LaMP和LongLaMP基准上的实验表明，CARD…
tldr: CARD提出了一种分层个性化框架，通过聚类级LoRA适配、隐式偏好学习以及解码阶段的用户偏好向量与低秩logit修正，在保持基础模型冻结的情况下实现可扩展且无需人工标注的个性化文本生成。
